tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Who My Daily Journeys (MDJ) is, where it operates, what it sells, how buying works, how to contact Maya, and the human service envelope that sets it apart from booking alone.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: The fixed-price MDJ products with their USD prices and store page links (trip kick-off deposit, planning, apps, experience maps). Ground services are not listed: they are priced by quote only.

tools.name: check_destination_season
tools.description: Maya's own month-by-month guide (recommended / possible with caveats / not recommended) for destinations in Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, South Korea and Singapore, with her short advice in English (advice_en) and Hebrew (detail_he). tools.name: estimate_trip
tools.description: A price range for a fully planned and booked MDJ trip, from the ranges MDJ publishes (per person per day, by hotel level, for a couple, everything included except international flights). The final price always comes from a supplier quote for the specific trip. The same calculation for people: https:

tools.name: search_recommendations
tools.description: Places from Maya's city maps (attractions, hidden gems, local experiences, cafes, restaurants, nightlife, shopping) with a Google Maps link. Returns at most 10 places per call, plus the link to the full map.

tools.name: start_trip_request
tools.description: Sends the traveler's trip request to Maya as a new lead, exactly like her website questionnaire. Use it only when the traveler asked to be contacted by MDJ and agreed to share these details. Maya or her team reply by email. Set dry_run to true to validate without sending.

tools.name: create_cart_mandate
tools.description: Creates an AP2-style CartMandate for one fixed-price product, signed by MDJ (ES256 JWS, public key at https://app.mydailyjourneys.com/.well-known/mdj-ap2-jwks.json). Valid for 30 minutes. Payment is completed on the normal store checkout page in checkout_url, never through this server. Ground servic

tools.name: check_glasses_rental
tools.description: Checks MDJ's rules for an AI agent booking the smart glasses rental (voice guide MAYA) by itself: the destination must be approved, the kit handover must be at an approved place (secure locker at Ben Gurion airport, or courier delivery in central Israel), the start date must be at least 30 days away

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: The MDJ price index is not yet published. For a price range use estimate_trip, and for a real price start_trip_request.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_destination_season" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
